Certainly, I can help you with that. You're asking about the baggage allowance for economy tickets, both for carry-on and checked bags.

For economy tickets, hold baggage is not included, so you would need to purchase it separately. The cost for an extra checked bag is thirty-five pounds. The standard weight limit for a checked bag is twenty-three kilograms. Bags over thirty-two kilograms are not accepted.
